title: minecraft instance data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/minecraft.yaml. Merged into the same template data as hosts.yaml. Validates structure only -- it cannot catch an instance missing from a host's `units`, a JDK whose package is undeclared, or a heap larger than the box has. tools/check-consistency covers the first two.

instances.description: One entry per server instance. The name is the systemd template instance: `vanilla` is started as minecraft@vanilla.service.

name.description: systemd template instance name, and the directory under ~/minecraft/.

jdk.description: Java major version. Derives package jdk<N>-openjdk and path /usr/lib/jvm/java-<N>-openjdk. Must be an LTS that Arch packages separately -- never the rolling jdk-openjdk, whose directory is renamed on each bump.

java_env.description: Env var the instance's modpack-shipped launcher reads to choose a JVM. That launcher stays unmanaged; the managed `start` wrapper sets this var and execs it.

xms.description: Initial heap, e.g. 2G. Only used by a managed launcher.

xmx.description: Maximum heap, e.g. 4G. Only used by a managed launcher.
